# Hypothesis 1: carcass-centered enrichment elevates herbaceous ANPP

The primary H1 analysis uses herbaceous biomass accumulated inside exclosures following initial clipping as an estimate of herbaceous ANPP. Distance is treated as a categorical factor because the four sampling distances are discrete, unevenly spaced, and no particular functional form is assumed.

```{r}
#| label: h1-primary
h1_exclosure <- exclose |>
  dplyr::filter(treatment == "exclosure") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_f = factor(
      distance_m,
      levels = c(2.5, 5, 10, 15)
    )
  )

# Primary H1 model
mod_h1 <- lmerTest::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~ distance_f + (1 | site),
  data = h1_exclosure
)

anova(mod_h1)

# Estimated marginal means and pairwise comparisons
h1_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(mod_h1, ~ distance_f)

h1_emm

pairs(h1_emm, adjust = "tukey")

multcomp::cld(
  h1_emm,
  Letters = letters,
  adjust = "tukey"
)
```


## Mechanistic (soil nutrient) analysis

We used NO₃, NH₄, and Bray-P to characterize plant-available soil nutrient availability. Nutrient concentrations were log-transformed and standardized before PCA. We first tested whether the multivariate nutrient environment differed among carcass distances using a Euclidean-distance PERMANOVA with permutations constrained within site. We then used PC1 as a composite nutrient-availability axis and tested whether herbaceous ANPP increased with PC1. Higher PC1 values were oriented to represent greater overall nutrient availability.

```{r}
#| label: h1-nutrient-mechanism

# ============================================================
# PREPARE NUTRIENT DATA
# ============================================================

# Exclosures only because these provide the ANPP estimate
# and soil values are duplicated across paired treatments.

h1_nutrients <- exclose |>
  dplyr::filter(
    treatment == "exclosure"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    site = factor(site),

    distance_f = factor(
      distance_m,
      levels = c(2.5, 5, 10, 15)
    ),

    # A-C: natural-log nutrient predictors, without adding 1.
    NO3_ln = log(NO3_mgkg),
    NH4_ln = log(NH3_mgkg),
    BrayP_ln = log(P_Bray_I_mgkg),

    # D: retain the original log1p inputs for PCA.
    NO3_log = log1p(NO3_mgkg),
    NH4_log = log1p(NH3_mgkg),
    BrayP_log = log1p(P_Bray_I_mgkg)
  )

# Source column NH3_mgkg represents ammonium.
# Natural logarithms require strictly positive concentrations.

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(h1_nutrients$NO3_ln)),
  all(is.finite(h1_nutrients$NH4_ln)),
  all(is.finite(h1_nutrients$BrayP_ln)),
  all(is.finite(h1_nutrients$herbaceous_biomass_kg))
)


# ============================================================
# A-C: INDIVIDUAL NUTRIENT MODELS
# ANPP ~ ln(nutrient) + (1 | site)
# ============================================================

mod_no3_anpp <- lme4::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~
    NO3_ln +
    (1 | site),
  data = h1_nutrients,
  REML = TRUE
)

mod_nh4_anpp <- lme4::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~
    NH4_ln +
    (1 | site),
  data = h1_nutrients,
  REML = TRUE
)

mod_brayp_anpp <- lme4::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~
    BrayP_ln +
    (1 | site),
  data = h1_nutrients,
  REML = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# A-C: P VALUES
# ML likelihood-ratio tests against a site-only model
# ============================================================

mod_nutrient_null_ml <- lme4::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~
    1 +
    (1 | site),
  data = h1_nutrients,
  REML = FALSE
)

mod_no3_anpp_ml <- update(
  mod_no3_anpp,
  REML = FALSE
)

mod_nh4_anpp_ml <- update(
  mod_nh4_anpp,
  REML = FALSE
)

mod_brayp_anpp_ml <- update(
  mod_brayp_anpp,
  REML = FALSE
)

no3_p <- stats::anova(
  mod_nutrient_null_ml,
  mod_no3_anpp_ml,
  refit = FALSE
)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]

nh4_p <- stats::anova(
  mod_nutrient_null_ml,
  mod_nh4_anpp_ml,
  refit = FALSE
)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]

brayp_p <- stats::anova(
  mod_nutrient_null_ml,
  mod_brayp_anpp_ml,
  refit = FALSE
)$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]


# ============================================================
# A-C: MARGINAL R2
# Fixed-effect variance / total model variance
# ============================================================

no3_var_fixed <- var(
  predict(mod_no3_anpp, re.form = NA)
)

no3_r2 <- no3_var_fixed / (
  no3_var_fixed +
    as.numeric(lme4::VarCorr(mod_no3_anpp)$site[1, 1]) +
    sigma(mod_no3_anpp)^2
)

nh4_var_fixed <- var(
  predict(mod_nh4_anpp, re.form = NA)
)

nh4_r2 <- nh4_var_fixed / (
  nh4_var_fixed +
    as.numeric(lme4::VarCorr(mod_nh4_anpp)$site[1, 1]) +
    sigma(mod_nh4_anpp)^2
)

brayp_var_fixed <- var(
  predict(mod_brayp_anpp, re.form = NA)
)

brayp_r2 <- brayp_var_fixed / (
  brayp_var_fixed +
    as.numeric(lme4::VarCorr(mod_brayp_anpp)$site[1, 1]) +
    sigma(mod_brayp_anpp)^2
)


# ============================================================
# A-C: PREDICTIONS AND 95% CONFIDENCE BANDS
# Population-level fitted means
# ============================================================

# Nitrate

no3_pred <- data.frame(
  NO3_ln = seq(
    min(h1_nutrients$NO3_ln),
    max(h1_nutrients$NO3_ln),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

no3_X <- model.matrix(
  ~ NO3_ln,
  data = no3_pred
)

no3_pred$estimate <- drop(
  no3_X %*% lme4::fixef(mod_no3_anpp)
)

no3_pred$SE <- sqrt(
  rowSums(
    (no3_X %*% as.matrix(vcov(mod_no3_anpp))) * no3_X
  )
)

no3_pred$lower <-
  no3_pred$estimate - qnorm(0.975) * no3_pred$SE

no3_pred$upper <-
  no3_pred$estimate + qnorm(0.975) * no3_pred$SE


# Ammonium

nh4_pred <- data.frame(
  NH4_ln = seq(
    min(h1_nutrients$NH4_ln),
    max(h1_nutrients$NH4_ln),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

nh4_X <- model.matrix(
  ~ NH4_ln,
  data = nh4_pred
)

nh4_pred$estimate <- drop(
  nh4_X %*% lme4::fixef(mod_nh4_anpp)
)

nh4_pred$SE <- sqrt(
  rowSums(
    (nh4_X %*% as.matrix(vcov(mod_nh4_anpp))) * nh4_X
  )
)

nh4_pred$lower <-
  nh4_pred$estimate - qnorm(0.975) * nh4_pred$SE

nh4_pred$upper <-
  nh4_pred$estimate + qnorm(0.975) * nh4_pred$SE


# Bray-P

brayp_pred <- data.frame(
  BrayP_ln = seq(
    min(h1_nutrients$BrayP_ln),
    max(h1_nutrients$BrayP_ln),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

brayp_X <- model.matrix(
  ~ BrayP_ln,
  data = brayp_pred
)

brayp_pred$estimate <- drop(
  brayp_X %*% lme4::fixef(mod_brayp_anpp)
)

brayp_pred$SE <- sqrt(
  rowSums(
    (brayp_X %*% as.matrix(vcov(mod_brayp_anpp))) * brayp_X
  )
)

brayp_pred$lower <-
  brayp_pred$estimate - qnorm(0.975) * brayp_pred$SE

brayp_pred$upper <-
  brayp_pred$estimate + qnorm(0.975) * brayp_pred$SE


# ============================================================
# PCA
# NO3 + NH4 + BRAY-P
# ============================================================

nutrient_matrix <- h1_nutrients |>
  dplyr::select(
    NO3_log,
    NH4_log,
    BrayP_log
  ) |>
  scale()

colnames(nutrient_matrix) <- c(
  "NO3",
  "NH4",
  "BrayP"
)

nutrient_pca <- stats::prcomp(
  nutrient_matrix,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)


# Orient PC1 so the sum of its nutrient loadings is positive.

if (
  sum(nutrient_pca$rotation[, 1]) < 0
) {
  nutrient_pca$x[, 1] <-
    -nutrient_pca$x[, 1]

  nutrient_pca$rotation[, 1] <-
    -nutrient_pca$rotation[, 1]
}

h1_nutrients$PC1 <-
  nutrient_pca$x[, 1]

summary(nutrient_pca)

nutrient_pca$rotation


# ============================================================
# OPTIONAL SUPPORTING TEST:
# DOES THE MULTIVARIATE NUTRIENT ENVIRONMENT VARY BY DISTANCE?
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

perm <- permute::how(
  nperm = 9999
)

permute::setBlocks(perm) <-
  h1_nutrients$site

mod_nutrient_distance <- vegan::adonis2(
  nutrient_matrix ~ distance_f,
  data = h1_nutrients,
  method = "euclidean",
  permutations = perm
)

mod_nutrient_distance


# ============================================================
# D: PC1 -> HERBACEOUS ANPP
# Adjusted for carcass-centered distance
# ============================================================

mod_pc1_anpp <- lmerTest::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~
    PC1 +
    distance_f +
    (1 | site),
  data = h1_nutrients,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(mod_pc1_anpp)

anova(mod_pc1_anpp)

performance::r2_nakagawa(mod_pc1_anpp)


# PC1 p-value from the adjusted mixed model

pc1_p_adjusted <- summary(mod_pc1_anpp)$coefficients[
  "PC1",
  "Pr(>|t|)"
]


# Marginal R2 includes both PC1 and distance

pc1_r2_marginal <- performance::r2_nakagawa(
  mod_pc1_anpp
)$R2_marginal


# Predictions averaged equally across distance levels

pc1_grid <- seq(
  min(h1_nutrients$PC1),
  max(h1_nutrients$PC1),
  length.out = 300
)

pc1_pred <- emmeans::emmeans(
  mod_pc1_anpp,
  ~ PC1,
  at = list(
    PC1 = pc1_grid
  ),
  weights = "equal",
  lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
) |>
  as.data.frame()


# ============================================================
# COLOURS AND DISPLAY SETTINGS
# ============================================================

col_A <- "#174F7A"  # Navy line
col_B <- "#BC571D"  # Burnt-orange line
col_C <- "#236746"  # Dark-green line
col_D <- "#713A90"  # Purple line

band_A <- "#AEDCF0" # Sky-blue band
band_B <- "#F4D58A" # Gold band
band_C <- "#B9E3CE" # Mint band
band_D <- "#DAC3E8" # Lavender band

point_colour <- "#303030"
point_alpha <- 0.78
band_alpha <- 0.65


# ============================================================
# SHARED FIGURE STYLE
# ============================================================

fig3_theme <- theme_classic(
  base_size = 9,
  base_family = "sans"
) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 9,
      margin = margin(t = 6)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.3
    ),
    plot.tag = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(
      6, 8, 8, 6
    )
  )

fig3_y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
  breaks = c(
    0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00
  ),
  labels = scales::label_number(
    accuracy = 0.01
  ),
  expand = expansion(
    mult = 0
  )
)

# NO3 VS HERBACEOUS ANPP

fig3b <- ggplot(
```

## H1 sensitivity analyses

Pretreatment clipping data are used to verify that plots assigned to exclosure and control treatments did not differ systematically before exclusion began.

```{r}
#| label: pretreatment-sensitivity

# Load only for this sensitivity analysis
exclosures_BEFORE <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "exclosures_BEFORE.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pre <- exclosures_BEFORE |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("control", "exclosure")
    ),
    herbaceous_biomass_kg =
      dplyr::coalesce(grass_biomass_kg, 0) +
      dplyr::coalesce(forb_biomass, 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    site,
    nickname,
    year,
    distance_m,
    treatment,
    herbaceous_biomass_kg
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = treatment,
    values_from = herbaceous_biomass_kg
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(control),
    !is.na(exclosure)
  )

t.test(
  pre$exclosure,
  pre$control,
  paired = TRUE
)
```

# Hypothesis 2: elevated production promotes herbivore consumption

The primary experimental H2 test compares paired exclosure and grazed-control plots directly. Pair identity accounts for the matching of plots within site-year-distance combinations. Because pair identity already encodes distance, the distance main effect is absorbed by the blocking term; the treatment effect tests whether grazed controls contain less biomass overall, and the treatment × distance interaction tests whether the magnitude of herbivore removal changes across the carcass-centered gradient.

```{r}
#| label: h2-paired-model

exclose_h2 <- exclose |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("control", "exclosure")
    ),
    distance_f = factor(
      distance_m,
      levels = c(2.5, 5, 10, 15)
    ),
    pair_id = interaction(site, distance_f, drop = TRUE)
  )

# Primary paired model
mod_h2 <- lmerTest::lmer(
  herbaceous_biomass_kg ~ treatment * distance_f +
    (1 | site) +
    (1 | pair_id),
  data = exclose_h2
)

anova(mod_h2)

# Planned exclosure-control contrast at each distance
h2_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  mod_h2,
  ~ treatment | distance_f
)

h2_contrasts <- emmeans::contrast(
  h2_emm,
  method = list(
    "exclosure - control" = c(-1, 1)
  )
)

summary(
  h2_contrasts,
  by = NULL,
  adjust = "holm",
  infer = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PANEL A

# Identify site types that were genuinely surveyed.

# Sum observed dung mass by physical site, site type, and dung group.

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dung_group)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(site_key, nickname, site_type, dung_group) |>

# Add zeros only where that site type was genuinely surveyed.

  tidyr::crossing(dung_group = c("elephant", "ungulate")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(

# Keep only physical sites with both carcass and matrix sampling.

  dplyr::pull(site_key)

h3_pair <- h3_site |>

  dplyr::select(

cat("\nPANEL A PAIR COUNTS\n")

# Paired tests.

h3_ungulate_test <- h3_pair |>

    data = age_predictions |>
      dplyr::filter(dung_group == "Ungulate"),

    fill = "#D55E00",
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = age_predictions |>
      dplyr::filter(dung_group == "Ungulate"),
    aes(x = age_years, y = estimate),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "#D55E00",
    linewidth = 1.05
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ dung_group) +
  ggbreak::scale_y_break(c(40, 45), scales = 0.25) +
  labs(x = "Carcass age (years)", y = NULL) +

    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),

  )

fig4b_inner <- (fig4b_elephant + fig4b_ungulate) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1))

fig4b <- patchwork::wrap_elements(full = fig4b_inner)


# ============================================================
# PANEL C
# 2023-2025 SITE-YEAR-DISTANCE-BAND DATA
# ============================================================

band_labels <- paste0(0:14, "-", 1:15)

band_areas <- tibble::tibble(
  distance_band = factor(band_labels, levels = band_labels),
  sampled_area_m2 = c(3.25, rep(4, 14)),
  band_mid = seq(0.5, 14.5, by = 1)
)

dung_carcass <- dung_h3 |>
  dplyr::filter(site_type == "carcass")

# Again: one row per PHYSICAL site x year, not per legacy ID x year.
siteyear_distance_meta <- dung_carcass |>
  dplyr::group_by(site_key, nickname, year_sampled) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    age_days = dplyr::first(age_days[!is.na(age_days)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(age_years = age_days / 365.25)

dung_banded_positive <- dung_carcass |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_band = cut(
      distance_m,
      breaks = 0:15,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = TRUE,
      labels = band_labels
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(dung_group),
    !is.na(distance_band),
    !is.na(mass_kg),
    mass_kg > 0
  )

site_distance_grid <- siteyear_distance_meta |>
  tidyr::crossing(
    distance_band = factor(band_labels, levels = band_labels),
    dung_group = c("elephant", "ungulate")
  )

dung_distance <- dung_banded_positive |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    site_key,
    nickname,
    year_sampled,
    distance_band,
    dung_group
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    band_mass_kg = sum(mass_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::right_join(
    site_distance_grid,
    by = c(
      "site_key",
      "nickname",
      "year_sampled",
      "distance_band",
      "dung_group"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(band_areas, by = "distance_band") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    band_mass_kg = dplyr::coalesce(band_mass_kg, 0),
    dung_density_g_m2 = band_mass_kg / sampled_area_m2 * 1000,
    site_key = factor(site_key),
    year_sampled = factor(year_sampled),
    age_years_sc = age_years - mean(age_years, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# ============================================================
# ZERO-INFLATED GAMMA DISTANCE MODELS
# ============================================================

fit_dung_models <- function(dgroup) {

  dat <- dung_distance |>
    dplyr::filter(dung_group == dgroup)

  # A: zero-inflation explained by carcass age.
  mod_A <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    dung_density_g_m2 ~
      band_mid +
      (1 | site_key) +
      (1 | year_sampled),
    ziformula = ~ age_years_sc + (1 | site_key),
    family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
    data = dat
  )

  # B: zero-inflation explained by carcass age + distance.
  mod_B <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    dung_density_g_m2 ~
      band_mid +
      (1 | site_key) +
      (1 | year_sampled),
    ziformula = ~ age_years_sc + band_mid + (1 | site_key),
    family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
    data = dat
  )

  # C: intercept-only zero-inflation component.
  mod_C <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    dung_density_g_m2 ~
      band_mid +
      (1 | site_key) +
      (1 | year_sampled),
    ziformula = ~ 1 + (1 | site_key),
    family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
    data = dat
  )

  models <- list(A = mod_A, B = mod_B, C = mod_C)

  aic_table <- AIC(mod_A, mod_B, mod_C) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("model") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model = dplyr::recode(
        model,
        mod_A = "A",
        mod_B = "B",
        mod_C = "C"
      ),
      delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC)
    )

  best_name <- aic_table$model[which.min(aic_table$AIC)]
  best_model <- models[[best_name]]

  # Null model for the CONDITIONAL distance effect, while preserving
  # the selected zero-inflation structure.
  distance_null <- switch(
    best_name,

    A = glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      dung_density_g_m2 ~
        1 +
        (1 | site_key) +
        (1 | year_sampled),
      ziformula = ~ age_years_sc + (1 | site_key),
      family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
      data = dat
    ),

    B = glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      dung_density_g_m2 ~
        1 +
        (1 | site_key) +
        (1 | year_sampled),
      ziformula = ~ age_years_sc + band_mid + (1 | site_key),
      family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
      data = dat
    ),

    C = glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      dung_density_g_m2 ~
        1 +
        (1 | site_key) +
        (1 | year_sampled),
      ziformula = ~ 1 + (1 | site_key),
      family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
      data = dat
    )
  )

  distance_LRT <- anova(distance_null, best_model)

  # Null model for the ZERO-INFLATION age term.
  age_null <- switch(
    best_name,

    A = glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      dung_density_g_m2 ~
        band_mid +
        (1 | site_key) +
        (1 | year_sampled),
      ziformula = ~ 1 + (1 | site_key),
      family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
      data = dat
    ),

    B = glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      dung_density_g_m2 ~
        band_mid +
        (1 | site_key) +
        (1 | year_sampled),
      ziformula = ~ band_mid + (1 | site_key),
      family = glmmTMB::ziGamma(link = "log"),
      data = dat
    ),

    C = NULL
  )

  age_LRT <- if (is.null(age_null)) NULL else anova(age_null, best_model)

  list(
    data = dat,
    models = models,
    aic = aic_table,
    best_name = best_name,
    best = best_model,
    distance_null = distance_null,
    distance_LRT = distance_LRT,
    age_null = age_null,
    age_LRT = age_LRT
  )
}

zi_elephant <- fit_dung_models("elephant")
zi_ungulate <- fit_dung_models("ungulate")

cat("\nPANEL C: ELEPHANT AIC / SELECTED MODEL\n")
print(zi_elephant$aic)
print(zi_elephant$best_name)
print(summary(zi_elephant$best))
cat("\nElephant conditional-distance LRT\n")
print(zi_elephant$distance_LRT)
cat("\nElephant ZI-age LRT\n")
print(zi_elephant$age_LRT)

cat("\nPANEL C: UNGULATE AIC / SELECTED MODEL\n")
print(zi_ungulate$aic)
print(zi_ungulate$best_name)
print(summary(zi_ungulate$best))
cat("\nUngulate conditional-distance LRT\n")
print(zi_ungulate$distance_LRT)
cat("\nUngulate ZI-age LRT\n")
print(zi_ungulate$age_LRT)

  dplyr::group_by(dung_group, band_mid) |>

) +

  labs(

# ============================================================
# APPENDIX FIGURE S2
# Coefficients from the SAME selected 2023-2025 ZI-Gamma models.
# This automatically stays synchronized with Figure 4C.
# ============================================================

extract_one_coefficient <- function(model, component, term, dung_label, panel_label) {

  mat <- if (component == "cond") {
    summary(model)$coefficients$cond
  } else {
    summary(model)$coefficients$zi
  }

  if (is.null(mat) || !(term %in% rownames(mat))) return(NULL)

  estimate <- unname(mat[term, "Estimate"])
  se <- unname(mat[term, "Std. Error"])
  p <- unname(mat[term, "Pr(>|z|)"])

  tibble::tibble(
    dung_group = dung_label,
    component = panel_label,
    estimate = estimate,
    conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * se,
    conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * se,
    p.value = p
  )
}

extract_dung_coefficients <- function(fit, dung_label) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    extract_one_coefficient(
      fit$best,
      "cond",
      "band_mid",
      dung_label,
      "Conditional distance"
    ),
    extract_one_coefficient(
      fit$best,
      "zi",
      "band_mid",
      dung_label,
      "ZI distance"
    ),
    extract_one_coefficient(
      fit$best,
      "zi",
      "age_years_sc",
      dung_label,
      "ZI age"
    )
  )
}

coef_plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  extract_dung_coefficients(zi_elephant, "Elephant"),
  extract_dung_coefficients(zi_ungulate, "Ungulate")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dung_group = factor(dung_group, levels = c("Elephant", "Ungulate")),
    component = factor(
      component,
      levels = c("Conditional distance", "ZI distance", "ZI age")
    )
  )

  facet_wrap(~ component, scales = "free_x") +
```

# Appendix outputs

```{r}
#| label: appendix-outputs

# ============================================================
# DUNG MODEL COEFFICIENTS
# Model-derived coefficients for Appendix Figure S1.
# Nothing is hard-coded.
# ============================================================

extract_dung_coefficients <- function(fit, label) {
  
  broom.mixed::tidy(
    fit$best,
    effects = "fixed",
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      (component == "cond" & term == "band_mid") |
      (component == "zi" & term %in% c("band_mid", "age_years_sc"))
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      
      dung_group = label,
      
      component = dplyr::case_when(
        component == "cond" & term == "band_mid" ~
          "Conditional distance",
        
        component == "zi" & term == "band_mid" ~
          "ZI distance",
        
        component == "zi" & term == "age_years_sc" ~
          "ZI age"
      ),
      
      estimate,
      conf.low,
      conf.high,
      p.value
    )
}


coef_plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  
  extract_dung_coefficients(
    zi_elephant,
    "Elephant"
  ),
  
  extract_dung_coefficients(
    zi_ungulate,
    "Other ungulates"
  )
  
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    dung_group = factor(
      dung_group,
      levels = c(
        "Elephant",
        "Other ungulates"
      )
    ),
    
    component = factor(
      component,
      levels = c(
        "Conditional distance",
        "ZI distance",
        "ZI age"
      )
    )
  )
```
